params.body:
`packages/app` goes: the old React version of gentells.com.

**Why:** CLAUDE.md said "delete both at cutover". gentells.com now points to the site box (142.132.191.187, Laravel). The pipeline box no longer serves it; only a stale nginx config still points at `packages/app/dist`.

**Removed**
- **`packages/app`:** 24 files, 8,857 lines.
- **The routes only it called** (checked against site, dashboard and studio):
  - `/trends/public` and `/trends/public/:id`;
  - `/articles/published` and `/articles/published/:id`;
  - `/newsletter/subscribe`, `/contact`, `/feedback`.

  The Laravel site has its own forms and newsletter.
- **The allow-list:** those routes come off the public allow-list (`public-routes.mjs`), and the test that pins the list follows.
- **`deploy.sh`:** the `build_frontend` step and the function behind it; nothing else built with it.
- **`fable-emphasize.mjs`:** only the old site read its output.
- **Clean-ups:** the now-unused imports in `routes-studio.mjs` and `server.mjs`; `.gitignore` lines; CLAUDE.md and README.

**After merge, on the box (needs root):** the nginx config `/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/gentells` and the untracked `packages/app/dist` can go. Nothing breaks if they stay, since no traffic reaches them.

Checks: 958 tests, 0 failures. A working no-undef lint over `packages`, `bin` and `test` finds 0 undefined names.
params.title: packages/app goes: gentells.com moved to the Laravel site
